title: Generate All Possible Recommendation Combinations
real_world_story: A recommendation platform has a small set of available items and wants to understand every possible combination that can be recommended to a user. Each item can either be selected or left out.

real_world_connection.target_represents: All possible subsets of items that can form recommendation combinations
real_world_connection.algorithm_represents: Power Set generation where each item has two choices: selected or not selected

problem_statement: Given N distinct item IDs, determine the total number of possible recommendation combinations. Each item can either be included or excluded from a combination.
task: Calculate the number of subsets in the power set of the available items.
input_format: The first line contains an integer N. The second line contains N space-separated distinct item IDs.
output_format: Print the total number of possible recommendation combinations.

examples.explanation: Three independent items produce 2^3 = 8 possible recommendation combinations.

expected_algorithm.name: Power Set
expected_algorithm.reason: Every item has two choices, included or excluded, so N items produce exactly 2^N possible combinations.

hint: Each item has two possible states.
One state includes the item and the other excludes it.
The number of combinations doubles for every additional item.
real_world_takeaway: Power-set concepts help recommendation systems understand how many possible item combinations can be generated from a small collection of available items.
